rationale: ZZZVault._join is private and reached only through nonReentrant activate/increase while operating/principalOperating enforce lifecycle before and after callbacks. Its captured supply is intentionally the pre-entrant denominator; _harvest only measures fee receipts and updates FeeController/Rewards reserves and indices, not Vault shares. The only ordinary bucketTotalShares write follows final contributionResult; canonicalWrite requires the fixed canonical companion and inert import state2, incompatible with this operating entry. Manager/child paths are fixed-module and guarded. Reordered Slither callee leaves do not supply a reachable reentrant share writer. This is bounded to the reviewed module/token trust model, not proof against corrupted upstream governance or dependencies.

ZZZLPPositionExecutor.close is fixed immutable-Manager only, requires the sealed current Manager binding, and is nonReentrant; Manager.close itself admits only Vault and is guarded. Both LPs and pool keys authenticate Vault custody. _settleTakePair accepts native payment only from the current fixed core; _finishNativeCredit clears nativeSender/nativeReceived before sending exact received ETH to the fixed Vault. That recipient receive path performs authenticated static sender validation, not an attacker-chosen payout. No reentrant mutating child entry can clear/remap the live residual; mappings/count change only after actual successful burns and failure reverts both legs. Read-only intermediate getters do not grant mutation or withdrawal. The two nativeReceived=0 leaves are presentation-order changes; no new execution order is inferred.

ZZZLPPositionExecutor.collect is fixed immutable-Manager only, sealed-binding checked and nonReentrant; Manager.collect is fixed-Vault only and guarded. It performs zero-liquidity decreases on authenticated main/residual positions, not principal mutation. Core ETH receipts are accepted only while nativeSender is that fixed core; the counter/sender are cleared before exact forwarding to fixed Vault, whose receive path authenticates a liquidity credit without arbitrary calls. Reentry cannot invoke another mutating child operation. A failure in either leg reverts the whole collection. Reordering reset writes in analyzer output adds no new reachable actor path; compromised token/core qualification remains outside this false-positive disposition.
